Dialogs.Dialog: Okay, let me see your tummy.
Hm？ Huh... ▲高嶺＊＊▲!? ...As a little kid!?
Geez. Didn't I tell you to call me Dr. Takane when we play doctor？ No-no.
Now then, show me your tummy.
(Hmm, this feels kind of ticklish... Okay, I'll take a deep breath like she says！)
Aren't you supposed to hold your breath for the stethoscope？
It's fine. Just now I was listening to your breathing.
You hold your breath when they listen to your heart. Papa said so.
Hehehe！ But I heard it really well. It was a lovely sound. You can relax now.
(When she said "playing doctor," my heart skipped a beat, but this isn't "playing," it's a "simulation.")
(You've been working hard since you were little, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
Yeah. I was thinking if Dr. Takane worked at a hospital, I wouldn't mind going every day. I'm looking forward to the future.
...Am I only allowed to become a doctor, I wonder？
Everyone says it. "I wonder what kind of doctor Manaka-chan will be."
I have never been asked, "What do you want to be when you grow up？"... Neither Papa nor Mama...
That's not true. I'm sure your Papa and Mama both want you to choose your own path, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It's fine, Manaka wants to be a doctor. I want to help Papa... Manaka will become a doctor.
(What a good kid！ My heart's squeezing...！)
...I just heard a murmur in your chest！
There, again！ You may have an arrhythmia！
Wait a sec, that was just my heart going "aww" at your story, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, it's not that kind of...
Don't worry about it, Nene-senpai. ...Tch, they really are in sync...
Yeah！ Our pair is the strongest, even at beach volleyball！
(I don't know why, but right now I'm in a beach volleyball match with ▲高嶺＊＊▲, ▲小早川＊▲, and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！)
(I don't really get it, but I can't lose this！)
Nice receive！ Here I go, Nene-senpai！
Heh. How's that？ Rinko's mind games.
That one couldn't be helped. Shake it off！
But we have to do something about that attack...
Don't let them fool you！ Watch your opponents closely！
Opponents... Watching ▲小早川＊▲ and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ closely...
Wh-What？ Looking at us with such serious eyes...
Hey, your eyes are kinda pervy, you know？
Then... oh, I know, I'll give you signals.
Don't take your eyes off my butt！
Got it！ I'll keep a close eye on your butt, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
All right, now's the time to check the signal！
(As expected of ▲高嶺＊＊▲, a toned, trained body, yet soft at the same time...)
(I can't take my eyes off this... For victory！)
Eh！ She's using Nene-san as a springboard!?
I'm fine... your butt is burned into my eyes, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
(...Hm？ Looking closely, it's all handsome guys around here...)
If you wish to take me as your wife, bring me the things I am about to name.
I might deign to marry whoever succeeds. Is that clear？
(And I think this is the first time I've seen ▲高嶺＊＊▲ so bossy...)
Do you want silk？ Or, do you want gold？
No, no, no... Celadon, surely？ Isn't that so, Princess？
(No, no, no, no... what are these people talking about)
Hmph. I have no interest in such things.
Diamond earrings, a pink gold bracelet, a mink coat, and a Rapda bag...
Ah, and sweet potato cakes▼ With lots of butter▼
Wait！ I won't let you get a head start！
Huh？ Well... I was just thinking they're all things you can't get in this world...
What do you mean how... you know？
...I see. So you are the one I've been waiting for...
What were you thinking？ Making me wait！
Because you didn't come quickly, things ended up like this... Reflect on it deeply！
...W-Well, if you've reflected, then fine. ...Geez. I was worried, you know.
Ah, my ride's here. Guess this is it fer you an' me.
What！ And why the Kansai dialect!?
No time, so I'll be headin' home！ See ya！
Your emotions sure swung wildly, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Maybe I've got some built-up stress...
Yes, a mermaid. A mermaid... who has long adored you.
You may think me forward, saying this so suddenly... but I've always watched you. From this sea.
...Right, I remember. The ship I was on was wrecked. You saved me？
You're kind and beautiful... and you saved my life. I would love to welcome you as my bride.
You and I are of different kinds...
But we can talk like this！ What's the problem！
...You're the prince of a nation, I'm the daughter of the king of mermaids. I'm not allowed to be with you.
Yes, a potion that can make me human.
If I drink this potion, I can be with you.
Mermaid princess, please, drink that potion！
...Princess, does the potion have side effects？
Yes... But I don't think there is anything more important to me than being with you.
Princess. Don't tell me, your voice...
Your voice！ It's so loud！ Turn down the volume！
Good grief... So that was the side effect...
How cruel！ My prince！ Even though I love you！
My name is Manaka Takane. It's a pleasure to meet you.
L-Likewise. It's a pleasure to meet yoo.
My, my. Don't be so nervous.
(Hah... Arranged marriage meetings sure are nerve-racking...)
You stay quiet. In the first place...
(Is this meeting going to be okay...)
(Begin... but what am I supposed to do？)
If there's anything you'd like to know, please ask, okay？
(I wonder what her hobbies are. Maybe I'll ask...)
Is there anything you'd like to ask？
(I'm curious what dishes she's good at...)
Hey！ What do you think you're doing！
Dear, calm down. ...And you, with a daughter not yet married... please be careful, okay？
(That's not something to do in front of her parents...)
(Her dad's glare is painful...！ Is it really okay to continue...)
Manaka-san, what are your favorite things...
Yes. I enjoy potatoes, a little...
Manaka-san, do you have a best dish？
Yes. Simmered potatoes, candied sweet potatoes... and the other day, a little sweet potato yokan...
......Well then, we'll leave the young couple to themselves...
I won't allow this！ I won't, I won't！
No！ Manaka！ I don't want anyone to take my Manaka away！
It's fine, Manaka. You stay here. Come on, let's go.
I'm sorry！ Don't pull my ear, Tamami！
(Her mom... handling her dad, with eighth dan combined in kendo and judo, so easily...)
A couple like that is my ideal.
Graceful ▲高嶺＊＊▲ in a kimono was cute too...
But a couple like that... what kind of...
(Let's see... maybe I'll ask "Your favorite things？")
Say "Suki na mono wa？" into the microphone
Say "Tokui na ryouri wa？" into the microphone
▲高嶺＊＊▲!? And what's with this classroom...
We're in the middle of a battle, don't let your guard down！
They've gotten this far already！ ...Take that！
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ doesn't seem to have time to talk...)
That's what I'm asking, the reason...
Because... because I want a boyfriend too！
(Fighting to get boyfriends？ I don't get it at all...)
Can't you tell by looking？ I'm a wreck.
Why go that far... What are you even fighting for？
A guy with a girlfriend wouldn't understand how I feel！
You've got a lot of energy for someone lying on the ground...
So, what's the point of this battle, anyway？
Have you forgotten the spirit of the revolution!?
Um, sorry. I just wanted to double-check！
The tree in the schoolyard... the bell in the clock tower... the slope of falling cherry blossoms...
Also a church where primroses bloom, a lighthouse by the sea...
If you confess there and succeed... the two of you will be happy forever！
Then even I could get a girlfriend！
(I feel like I've heard of these somewhere, or maybe not...)
Don't you think Towano High needs a legend like that too!?
I don't know... You don't have to force something that doesn't exist...
Takane... I know it's hard, but...
Anyone who won't support the revolution must be purged from the alliance as a dissident...
No way！ ...But we got together without any legend！ We found happiness, didn't we！
We don't need a legend. The two of us... will become a legend！
Sorry, Miyoshi-san. I'm quitting the revolution♪
Ugh... she's got a boyfriend after all...
Now that that's settled, let's escape from here.
How？ It's a battlefield all around us, right？
Whoa, wait！ Huh... inside the bazooka？ No way, no way！ I won't fit！
It's fine, if I push hard enough...
I'll shoot you out of here with this. Ready...
What's wrong, Takane！ Is that all the guts you've got！
Get up！ At this rate, you'll never beat Tonarino High！
(She's struggling... But！ If our ace Takane can't overcome this, there's no future for Towano High volleyball！)
Don't give up！ Pull yourself together！
Guts, guts, and more guts！ Come on, what's wrong！
(She's in tears... She is a girl, after all. Is this her limit...)
Please！ Even if it hurts, even if it's sad... I'm fine！
What's wrong！ I thought you could do it！
...Why is it... my heart is leaping...！
(She really does look like she's having fun...)
(Did she just end that with a heart？)
Taking your spikes with my whole body, Coach... I'm so happy！
Takane...！ I'm happy to coach a player like you too！ Takaneee！
A dream... It was a strange dream...
Even in dreams, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ hates to lose...
(Today's a date with ▲高嶺＊＊▲... Come to think of it, it's my first time in Shibuya.)
(She's late... It's rare for her to be late.)
Totally hype, right？ Isn't it super rad？
(There's no way that's a real phrase...)
(She's working her phone with one index finger...)
"It's a greeting, like "hi" or "yoo-hoo"..." it says. Like, obviously？
Huh, dollars？ I'm not exactly rich, though...
Not that, it means "what do we do？" So, for now, all-nighter kara？
Hehe. So, like... shall we go do karaoke all night？
Sure... wait, all night is a no！ And what do you mean "for now"...
(She studied up because our date's in Shibuya...)
Well, this much？ Or would you have liked it darker？
You had a ribbon this color too...
Ah... um... clip-on earrings. Papa... my old man would freak out.
This deco phone is mega cute, right？ Manaka decorated it herself.
(She does seem good at this kind of thing...)
That billboard？ Iwana-chan is totally cute, right？ I seriously respect her～.
Um... I wasn't doing it well, was I？
It's not about doing it well... What's with you, forcing yourself like that？
...So you don't like this kind of Manaka, after all.
It's not a lie！ I love you no matter what, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Then will you be a gyaru-o just for Manaka？
...I will！ I'll be one！ Please let me be one！
Teehee▼ Manaka's gonna die of cuteness☆♪
Then let's go buy clothes and hit the tanning salon right away？
You're gonna be a gyaru-o, right？ C'mon, c'mon.
If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ actually turned out like that...
(Is it the makeup that makes her seem different from usual？)
(Don't tell me, that thing on her ear is...)
(Huh, was her phone always like that？)
(Who's the girl on that billboard over there？)
Ah... are you awake now, sweetie？
(I'm being held by ▲高嶺＊＊▲... I'm a baby!?)
Mm, are we a little grumpy？
(I can't talk... Did I really turn into a baby...)
Is it because Papa's not here？ Papa's late, isn't he？
(Right, if there's a kid, there's a father... Who is it！)
I hope Papa comes home soon, don't you？
You want to see Papa... Mama does too. Just kidding.
(Which means... I'm my own kid？ This is confusing...)
Ah... sorry, are you worried about me？
It's okay, it's not because I'm sad...
Waiting for my husband to come home, together with you...
Getting married, and then you were born...
Two is better than one, and three is better than two...
I realized how wonderful it is when your family grows...
And it makes me so happy...
I wonder if Papa and Mama felt this happy when I was born...
Before you were born, I was sometimes a little lonely...
But I'm okay now. Because I have you.
(How long has it been since ▲高嶺＊＊▲ and I washed up on this deserted island...)
(We've gotten totally used to island life...)
(Hm？ Come to think of it, there was a spring over this way...)
(I have to make sure she doesn't notice...)
(I have to cover it up somehow...)
(Okay, time for the classic animal impression！)
There are a lot on this island. ...I hope they don't attack...
So there are cats on this island too...
Amazing. There are tanuki on this island too...
That's the first time I've heard a cryptid's call...
(Whoops, stepped on a branch. What a cliche way to get caught...)
(Good, good. Just to be safe, one more push...)
Right, of course not. It couldn't be.
Shout like a cryptid into the microphone
Shout like a mysterious creature into the microphone
Do an animal impression into the microphone
